$comment: Root-cause rules for the generator/normalizer taxonomy (docs/m14/). First match wins. `category`: A = documented-supported contract, compiler bug; B = browser-compatible construct not implemented; C = library adapter (browser equivalent exists); D = no browser equivalent / intentional refusal. `layer`: the first compiler layer where the construct stops being representable.

rules.cause: a list of widgets left in props (N8)
a screen's own constructor parameter forwarded across a route boundary (N11 multi-hop provenance)
a live object passed across a route boundary (a URL carries an identifier, not an object graph)
Riverpod: ref.watch/read/listen, providers, notifiers

rules.match: top-level `final`/`const` .*initializer could not be lowered|initializer of `[A-Za-z]*Provider`
rules.cause: a top-level provider whose initializer builds a package object
a theme built by a helper/ColorScheme from computed values: no token for the Material role a widget paints
Theme.of(context)/extension<T>() and design-system extensions on BuildContext

rules.layer: generator (no callee signature for a package/SDK function)
rules.cause: named arguments to a package/SDK callee the kit does not mirror (Supabase, showModalBottomSheet, Color ops, …)

rules.match: is one of this application's own classes, and this generator does not emit class declarations
rules.cause: construction of a class that depends on an unsupported package

rules.match: extends a class this generator does not emit
rules.cause: a project class extending a package class (StateNotifier, Notifier, …)

rules.match: reads a member of|calls a member of
rules.cause: member of a package class with no runtime model (dio beyond the subset, audio, Supabase, …)
an expression the analyzer preserved verbatim (opaque)

rules.match: BRG3001\] `[A-Za-z]+` is not a Flutter widget
rules.cause: a widget with no runtime mapping
a top-level function whose body contains any construct above
a top-level/static variable whose initializer contains any construct above
a typed catch on a type that cannot be tested at runtime
interpolating a value whose Dart text cannot be reproduced from its static type (num, enum, class, dynamic elements)
a colour computed at runtime
two project widgets of the same name in different libraries (monorepo) emit to one file: refused; needs unique component file/export naming
a navigation that constructs its destination inline
a name with no declaration in the program (usually a package or a private symbol from a construct above)
an expression form with no lowering
a construct the generator names as unsupported
a GlobalKey: a handle on a live widget State, no UIR construct
a MaterialApp parameter with no equivalent (builder, onUnknownRoute, localization, …)
a widget parameter the runtime cannot honour (refused by name)
unclassified — needs a rule
